name: account.read
description: A brand's account on one platform with its sealed tokens, or nothing when none is linked. Internal: for packages/connect only, never a screen.
sql: select jsonb_build_object('accountId', a.account_id, 'username', a.username, 'tokens', a.tokens, 'details', a.details, 'updatedAt', brandbase.iso(a.updated_at)) as result from brandbase.accounts a where a.brand_id = :brand and a.platform = :platform
